newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Port of Singapore August container throughput down.
newsitem.headline: Port of Singapore August container throughput down.

text.p: Port of Singapore Authority (PSA) said container throughput fell to 1.129 million TEUs (twenty-foot equivalent units) in August from 1.144 million TEUs registered in July.
Total cargo tonnage moving through Singapore in August was 26.035 million tonnes, against July's 27.257 million tonnes, the PSA said in its latest monthly report.
In August, 9,888 vessels called at the port, compared with 10,045 in July.
Bunker fuel sales for 380 centistoke fuel oil was 745,400 tonnes in August, down from 801,400 tonnes in July.
The 180 centistoke fuel sales was also lower at 404,600 tonnes against July's 444,400 tonnes.
